records.name: Casa Soccer League
records.summary: A nonprofit adult soccer league run for players by players. Members play 11 a side, 7 a side or 5 a side on turf, with certified referees.
records.what_you_do: Sign up to play, get placed on a team or in a league, and play matches through the season.

locations.label: Throughout Philadelphia (fields not named on the site)

cost.text: Fees not stated on the site

first_step.how: Use the sign up link on the site; the steps are not spelled out there
first_step.basis: Adult leagues with a public sign up link, though the page does not say how a new player is placed

records.notes: The site is reachable, but the older phillysoccer.org address failed on three tries (TLS error). The newest dated item is 2024-10-05, taken from photo file names, so status is unknown. A 2024 Philadelphia Union announcement described an adult league with Casa at WSFS Bank Sportsplex; not verified as current. Confirm before publishing.

records.name: Philadelphia Adult League Softball (PALS)
records.summary: Mixed gender slow pitch softball for adults. Weeknight and Sunday leagues play at a West Philadelphia rec center.
records.what_you_do: Join a team or sign on as a free agent, then play weekly games. Umpires are paid per game.

schedule.text: Leagues run Monday, Tuesday and Thursday evenings (6 to 10 pm) and Sunday days (10 am to 5 pm). Two seasons a year, the first starting in spring and the second in July.

locations.label: Tiffany Fletcher Rec Center, formerly Mill Creek Rec Center

cost.text: Teams pay $865 per season plus $20 per game for umpires. Free agents pay $80 per person plus $20 per game for umpires.

first_step.how: Email the league to join the waitlist. The summer and fall 2026 season is sold out.
first_step.basis: Current registration is full, so the way in is a waitlist

records.notes: The sold out notice for the summer and fall 2026 season has no date, but it refers to 2026. The newest explicitly dated items are 2025 (Hall of Fame, Pride in the Park). Older prices from a 2022 Inquirer roundup were not used. Site lists Facebook, Instagram and X accounts without URLs in the fetch.

records.name: City of Brotherly Love Softball League
records.summary: A slow pitch softball league for LGBTQIA+ players and their allies. Divisions run from recreational to competitive, and the league offers new player clinics and social events.
records.what_you_do: Register for a season, get placed on a team in your division, and play weekly games.

cost.text: Registration cost not stated on the site

first_step.how: Register for 2026 Fall Ball on the league's registration page, or email join@cblsl.org to ask about next season
first_step.basis: The site welcomes players of all abilities, from beginners to competitive, and runs new player clinics

records.notes: The site redirects to a league platform (cblsl.leagueapps.com) and was read there. Fields and meeting places are on a Fields page that was not read, so no location is recorded. Divisions: open competitive, open upper and lower recreational, women's plus B/C and D/E. Older 2022 Inquirer price of $70 not used.

records.name: Philly Kickball League
records.summary: A recreational adult kickball league. Teams play on Sunday afternoons in spring and early summer at Starr Garden on Lombard Street.
records.what_you_do: Register for the season, get placed on a team, and play Sunday games with a playoff session at the end.

schedule.text: Sundays, 2 to 6 pm. The 2026 season ran April 12 to July 26, with playoffs starting July 26. The 2027 season is not posted yet.

cost.text: The site says all fees go back into the league but does not list an amount. Older listings gave $36 per person (Philadelphia Magazine guide, date not shown) and $75 (Inquirer, December 2022).

first_step.how: Register through the league's Eventbrite page for the current season
first_step.basis: Open to the public with a public registration page; no newcomer program stated

records.notes: The site posts the 2026 spring season with opening day April 12, 2026. It does not show coed, men's or women's divisions or skill levels. Players must be 21 or older according to a 2022 Inquirer roundup, not verified on the league site, so not recorded.

records.name: Heyday Athletic
records.summary: A company that runs adult sports leagues in the Philadelphia area, including basketball, soccer, kickball, softball, pickleball and tennis. Players join a team or sign up as free agents for a season.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for a league as a player or team, or register for a single event, then play organized games.

schedule.text: Seasonal leagues. The site advertises winter league sign ups, and upcoming events run October 17 to November 20, 2026. League days and season dates are not stated.

cost.text: Price not stated on the company's site. A December 2022 Inquirer roundup listed $50 to $100 to join.

first_step.how: Use the Join A Winter League or Start Playing button on the site, or register for a single event
first_step.basis: Public league sign up with no approval step stated

records.notes: A company, not a neighborhood group, so it is listed for its adult leagues. Venues are not named on the page. The old phillyleagues.com address now redirects to this company. Philadelphia Sports Network in older listings may be the same company; not verified. Cost is from a 2022 source because the site does not show a price.

records.name: Volo Sports
records.summary: A company that runs adult kickball leagues in Philadelphia in coed and open formats, plus Thursday drop in sessions. Solo players can sign up as free agents.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for a league or a drop in session, or join as a free agent and get placed on a team.

schedule.text: Thursday drop ins, 6:45 to 8:30 pm. League days and times are not listed. A free three week kickball and flip cup series has sessions on October 8 and October 22 (year not shown).

cost.text: Price to join leagues not stated on the page

first_step.how: Use the Find a drop in link for a Thursday session, or the Sign up link for a league
first_step.basis: Drop in sessions are listed publicly and solo players can join as free agents

records.notes: A commercial league operator. The listed drop in dates have no year, so status is probably active rather than confirmed. Formats listed are coed and open, 9v9 to 12v12. The Starfinder Foundation is the drop in venue; its address is not on the page read. The page mentioned softball as coming soon in an earlier search summary; not recorded.

records.name: Kensington Soccer Club
records.summary: A youth soccer club in Kensington, founded in 2010. It runs rec, after school and travel teams, and it looks for volunteer coaches for them.
records.what_you_do: Kids play on rec, after school or travel teams. Volunteer coaches lead training and games and help manage equipment.

cost.text: The site says programs are open regardless of ability to pay. No fee is listed.

first_step.how: To coach, email the volunteer coordinator at volunteer@kensingtonsoccer.org. To play, contact the club.
first_step.basis: The site names a volunteer coordinator and open programs; no newcomer program is stated

records.notes: No dated items on the site, so status is probably active from a working site. The age range, schedule, and any coach background check or training are not stated on the site, so none are recorded. The volunteer page lists referee, SAVE volunteer, special events helper and videographer roles too.

records.name: Philadelphia Youth Sports Collaborative
records.summary: A Philadelphia network working to bring more community coaches and youth sports programs to kids. It offers membership, training, and resources for parents, coaches and referees.
records.what_you_do: Join as a member, take part in coach training and workshops, or ask how to coach with one of its partner programs.

cost.text: Membership and coach program costs are not stated

first_step.how: Use the Become a Member page or the general contact page to ask how to coach. The coach sign up steps were not shown.
first_step.basis: The site lists membership, but the coach sign up process was not stated

records.notes: Its March 27, 2026 article says community coaches are getting scarce and names the Octavius Catto Baseball League. The article's claims about the city's coach recruiting programs are not recorded as facts about this network.

records.name: Octavius Catto Baseball League
records.summary: Entry level baseball for kids ages 6 to 12, started in 2025. In March 2026 its league was named as one that needs more volunteer coaches.
records.what_you_do: Kids play entry level baseball. Volunteers can coach.

cost.text: Cost not stated in the source

first_step.how: Ask the Philadelphia Youth Sports Collaborative how to reach the league. No league contact was found.

records.notes: Known only from one March 2026 article on the Philadelphia Youth Sports Collaborative site. No league website was found, the article does not say whether the league is a member of that collaborative, and the meeting place and season are not established.

records.name: Sons of Ben
records.summary: An independent, nonprofit supporters group for the Philadelphia Union, founded in January 2007. Fans cheer with the group at Union matches and can join as members.
records.what_you_do: Cheer with the group at Union matches, and join as a member through the club's membership page.

cost.text: Membership cost not stated on the site

first_step.how: Use the Join link on the site, which goes to the membership page
first_step.basis: The group says it welcomes all Union supporters, including fans who cannot attend matches; joining is through a public link

records.notes: The home page shows no dated news or events, so status is probably active from a working site. A 2026 membership link is the only current sign. Earlier press (2016 to 2021) names other leaders; current leadership not verified. The site lists its membership link and meeting minutes pages without contents.

records.name: Stonewall Sports Philadelphia
records.summary: A recreational sports and social group for the LGBTQIA+ community. It runs leagues and events including kickball, volleyball, bowling, trivia and a running group.
records.what_you_do: Join a league or event as a player, or come to social nights and wellness sessions.

cost.text: Cost not stated. The site asks visitors to subscribe to monthly updates to get started.

first_step.how: Subscribe to the monthly updates on the site to hear about league sign ups, or email info@stonewallphilly.org
first_step.basis: Open to the community with a public sign up path; no newcomer program is stated

records.notes: The newest dated item is a 2026 sponsors heading with no month, so status is active but no month is recorded. Volleyball, bowling, bocce and trivia fall outside our sports tags, so they appear in the summary only. Their 2022 price list is not used.

records.name: Philadelphia Falcons Soccer Club
records.summary: A soccer club in Philadelphia whose members are mostly LGBTQIA+ players. It runs weekly indoor and outdoor pickup games, leagues and tournaments, and welcomes anyone who wants to play.
records.what_you_do: Join the club, then play weekly pickup games, a league or a tournament.

schedule.text: Weekly indoor and outdoor pickup games. Days and times are not stated on the page.

cost.text: Membership cost not stated. A scholarship application is offered.

first_step.how: Sign up through the Membership page on the club's LeagueApps site. Non-members sign a waiver.
first_step.basis: A public membership page, a scholarship option and a waiver for non-members; no newcomer program is stated

records.notes: The site redirects to a league platform (phillyfalcons.leagueapps.com) and was read there. It has no dated posts and no season is shown, so status is probably active from a working site. No email or phone is published. A 2022 Inquirer roundup price ($30 to $50) was not used.

records.name: Pennsylvania Center for Adapted Sports
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit for people with disabilities. It runs about 13 sport and wellness programs year round, including rowing, cycling, kayaking, skiing, climbing, sitting volleyball, yoga and youth track and field.
records.what_you_do: Take part in a program such as rowing, cycling, kayaking or youth track and field, open to people with disabilities.

cost.text: Fees and how to join are not stated on the site. It links to an eligibility document, which was not read.

first_step.how: Use the contact page on the site, and read the eligibility document it links
first_step.basis: A public contact page and a program list; the eligibility document was not read

records.notes: Its only dated items (a Cinco de Mayo ride and a spring garden cleanup) show no year, so status is probably active from a working site. The site shows no phone or email, only a contact page and social accounts. An older directory lists ages 4 to 74; not verified on the site, so not recorded.

records.name: Katie's Komets
records.summary: A co-ed wheelchair basketball team for young players with lower limb impairments in the Philadelphia area. It has prep and varsity divisions and is always looking for new players.
records.what_you_do: Play on a wheelchair basketball team in a prep or varsity division.

cost.text: Joining fees are not stated on the site

first_step.how: Email info@katieskomets.org or use the site's contact form to ask about joining
first_step.basis: The site says it is always looking for new players and gives a direct contact

records.notes: The only date on the site is a 2023 footer, which is not evidence, so status rests on a working site with no dated items. Prep players are 13 and under; varsity players must be in school. Practice and game venues are not stated, and the Schedule and Media pages were not read.

records.name: Philadelphia Cricket Club
records.summary: A private family country club with a cricket program. Members play cricket as an 11 player team sport, and the club also offers pickleball, fitness and bridge.
records.what_you_do: Members play cricket as a team, or take part in the club's other sports and social events.

cost.text: Membership types and fees are not stated on the site

first_step.how: Membership is needed to take part. The site has a Membership page and a Guest Information page, which were not read.
first_step.basis: Membership or guest access comes before you can see what cricket is like at the club, and the way in is not clear from the page

records.notes: Cricket is listed as a team sport on the recreation page with no dates. The pickleball calendar lists 2026 events from April 22 to July 4, which is the newest dated evidence. Non-member access to cricket is not stated. Names like Philadelphia Cricket Club on padel listings are unrelated; ignore them.

notes: Used all 10 WebSearch calls (hard cap reached), about 38 fetches. Searches covered adult rec leagues, pickup play, adaptive sports, youth volunteer coaches, cricket, pickleball and tennis, LGBTQ leagues, supporters groups, hockey, and Casa. Gaps: basketball (only Heyday recorded), football and rugby (rugby and ultimate skipped per the brief), hockey (rinks and women's and sled teams are leads), and tennis clubs (mostly businesses or members-only). Non-tag sports noted in leads: dodgeball, bowling, volleyball (Stonewall summary only). Public courts (FDR Park, Seger, Awbury, MLK, Fishtown Rec) and Capitolo Playground are places, not groups, so not recorded. New Jersey adaptive groups (Miracle League of Camden County, Athletes with Disabilities Network, Wings of Steel, Weisman Sled Stars) are outside Philadelphia and were not recorded. Also noted: a Philadelphia Union announcement from 2024 described an adult league with Casa at WSFS Bank Sportsplex, not verified. Mistake to report: an accidental placeholder background task was created during the run and was withdrawn right away; it was never shown as a real suggestion.
